title: Analysing the effect of sustainable entrepreneurship on the family-based moonj craft and pattal (leaf plate) industry in the handicraft sector in India
core_idea: This study examines how sustainable entrepreneurship and related dynamic capabilities influence the livelihoods of family-based handicraft businesses—specifically moonj craft and pattal (leaf plate) production in India—by surveying family members of female-owned enterprises and exploring the role of digital technology, social media, and AI in post-pandemic marketing and business development, using PLS-SEM and SPSS-26 for analysis.
tldr: Investigates the role of sustainable entrepreneurship and digital/technological capabilities in shaping the livelihoods and business practices of family-based moonj craft and pattal artisans in India, with a survey-based empirical analysis focused on female-led traditional handicraft enterprises.
